property_summary: For any caller who is the contract owner and any non-zero receiver/address and positive amount, calling sendTo will either revert on failure (so a failing transfer causes the call to revert) — the reference using transfer always reverts on failure, while the mutant using send may silently succeed (not revert) when the low-level payment fails.
change_summary: Changed transfer to send, which returns a boolean and does not revert on failure; this alters observable behavior when transfer would have reverted.
